target: Warum fragst du denn nicht einfach den Lehrer?
english: Why don't you just ask the teacher?
tip: Dropping denn into a question makes it sound curious and friendly rather than blunt: warum fragst du denn softens the tone without adding meaning.

target: Das ist ja wohl das Mindeste, was man erwarten kann.
english: That's surely the least one can expect.
tip: ja wohl adds an indignant 'surely, obviously': 'Das ist ja wohl das Mindeste' = that is surely the very least you can expect.

target: Der Professor erklärte, dieses Experiment beweise seine Theorie.
english: The professor explained that this experiment proved his theory.
tip: Reported speech shifts to subjunctive I: beweise instead of beweist marks the statement as the professor's claim, not the narrator's own fact.

target: Na gut, dann machen wir es eben auf deine Art.
english: Alright then, we'll just do it your way.
tip: Here eben means just or simply and marks resigned acceptance: dann machen wir es eben so signals giving in to how things are.

target: Es bedarf einer gründlichen Analyse der zugrundeliegenden Faktoren.
english: A thorough analysis of the underlying factors is required.
tip: The verb bedürfen takes a genitive object: es bedarf einer gründlichen Analyse. It is a formal way of saying something is needed.

target: Hast du etwa die ganze Torte allein aufgegessen?
english: Did you actually eat the whole cake by yourself?
tip: In a yes/no question, etwa adds disbelief and expects the answer no: hast du etwa die Torte gegessen carries a note of accusation.

target: Du hättest ruhig etwas sagen können, anstatt zu schweigen.
english: You could well have said something instead of staying silent.
tip: As a particle ruhig means go ahead or it would have been fine to: du hättest ruhig etwas sagen können. It has nothing to do with quiet.

target: Er hat die Skulptur restaurieren lassen.
tip: lassen plus an infinitive means having something done for you, not doing it yourself. Restaurieren lassen = had it restored.

target: Das ist ja unglaublich, dass er die Prüfung bestanden hat!
english: That's incredible that he passed the exam!
tip: ja in 'Das ist ja unglaublich' stresses the fact as plain to see, a reaction, with no separate word in English.

target: Komm doch mal vorbei, wenn du in der Gegend bist.
english: Do come by when you're in the area.
tip: doch mal warms a bare command into a friendly invite: 'Komm doch mal vorbei' softens 'Komm vorbei' to why don't you drop by.

target: Guck mal, da drüben ist ein Reh auf der Wiese!
english: Look, there's a deer over on the meadow!

target: Wo bleibt er denn nur? Er müsste längst hier sein.
english: Where on earth is he? He should have been here long ago.
